_comment: Njordlinger Combat Gameplay Overhaul - the runesmith (PLAN.md phase 4 step 3, D22; Q28 DEFAULT set 2026-10-26 while the
owner slept, for Fable's review and the owner's word): Thorvar Stone-Speaker, a dragon-tongue scholar staying at the
Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood, below Bleak Falls Barrow's word wall. His quest in one line: learn a word of power at
any word wall and tell him. Then he sets and takes out soul stones (fee: one soul gem of the stone's tier) and sells
stones. Dialogue is text only (Fuz Ro D-oh shows it as subtitles); the plugin's text is English (as every ESP string of
this mod so far). tools/PluginBuild builds it.

D22 revised (STONE-CRAFTING.md, 2026-10-26): he sells nothing; he grinds soul gems into dust and cuts stones of learned words; the fee is one dust of the stone's tier; taking a stone out is free. The Barter topic became Grind (same record); Craft is built late.

ENCHANTING-OFF.md 7 (the owner 20:14): 'whileOn' lines are spoken only while Enchanting is On (global NJCGO_RunesmithEnchantingOn, kept by the SKSE plugin); with Enchanting Off he only adds slots and the player sets stones anywhere. AddSlot is built late.
DESIGN-RETHINK.md 14 (the owner 20:56): D28 withdrawn - all five services in every game; the 'whileOn' conditions are gone (the global record stays so no form ID moves).

quest.name: Words in Stone

stages.10: I met Thorvar Stone-Speaker at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood. He sets soul stones into gear, but only for one who has learned a word of power.
stages.100: Thorvar now grinds my soul gems into dust, cuts soul stones of the words I have learned, and sets them for one dust of each stone's size.

quest.objective: Learn a word of power at a word wall, then return to Thorvar

say: Words of the dragon tongue, set in soul stones. A sword that holds the word for fire burns what it strikes.
But a word means nothing from a mouth that never spoke one. Learn a word of power at one of the old walls, then come back to me.

topics.prompt: Where would I find a word of power?
say: On the walls in the old barrows. Bleak Falls Barrow, up the mountain from here, has one.

topics.prompt: I have learned a word of power.
say: I can hear it in your breath. Good.

Bring me soul gems and I will grind them to dust. One orichalcum ingot and dust of the right size, and I cut you a stone of any word you have learned. Setting a stone costs one pinch of its dust; taking one out costs nothing.
Hand them over. Filled ones give more.
Which word? Only one you have read on a wall.

topics.prompt: Add a rune slot to my gear.
say: Orichalcum and a soul gem for each slot. Three is all any piece will hold.
